name: Barchart OnDemand
tagline: Futures, options, and equities market data API for trading tools and research
description: Barchart OnDemand provides REST access to real-time and historical market data across equities, futures, options, forex, and related instruments. Commonly used by trading platforms, research apps, and quant tools for quotes, charts, fundamentals, and options chains. Developers authenticate with an API key obtained through Barchart’s commercial OnDemand plans.

auth.details: API key via get parameter (apikey=YOUR_API_KEY) or request auth; commercial signup required

pricing.paid_plans: Commercial OnDemand plans; contact sales for pricing

use_cases: get real-time or delayed equity quotes by symbol
fetch historical futures and options price history
retrieve market profiles and fundamentals for equities
power charting and research apps with OHLC data
